'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Siege of Jabalia]]
****[[Kamal Adwan Hospital siege]]
*****[[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli troops]] storm the Kamal Adwan Hospital in [[Jabalia]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-forces-kill-38-people-khan-younis-storm-north-gaza-hospital-say-medics-2024-10-25/ (Reuters)]
****Three [[Israel]]i soldiers from the [[Armored Corps (Israel)|Armored Corps]] are killed in an [[Improvised explosive device|IED blast]] in Jabalia in the Gaza Strip. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2024-10-25/ty-article/.premium/three-soldiers-killed-by-explosive-device-in-jabalya-northern-gaza/00000192-c45a-d3d8-a7be-d45a4df20000 (Haaretz)]
***[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
****Israeli airstrikes in Gaza kill 72 people, including at least 38 in [[Khan Younis]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-forces-kill-38-people-khan-younis-storm-north-gaza-hospital-say-medics-2024-10-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2024 Kursk offensive]], [[Foreign involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Ukraine]] reports that the first [[Korean People's Army|North Korean units]] have entered the active "warzones" in [[Russia]]'s [[Kursk Oblast]]. The North Korean soldiers are reportedly under the command of Deputy Defence Minister [[Yunus-bek Yevkurov]]. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20241025001300315?input=tw (Yonhap News Agency)]
**[[Dnipro strikes (2022–present)|Dnipro strikes]]
***A Russian missile attack on a residential area in [[Dnipro]], central Ukraine, kills five people and injures 21 others. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-kyiv-attack-drone-4325c6b695c010cb2556e48f2efa275c (AP)]
**[[Kyiv strikes (2022–present)|Kyiv strikes]], [[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***One person is killed and five others are injured when a Russian [[drone warfare|drone]] strikes a residential building in [[Solomianskyi District]], [[Kyiv]], Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-drone-hits-kyiv-residential-building-triggers-fires-officials-say-2024-10-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
***Two people are killed and six others are injured when a rocket fired from [[Lebanon]] hits a building in the town of [[Majd al-Krum]] in northern [[Israel]]. [https://m.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-826075 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
***Two cameramen and a technician working for [[Al Mayadeen]] and [[Al-Manar]] are killed and several other people are injured when an Israeli [[airstrike]] hits a [[guest house]] housing journalists in [[Hasbaya]], Lebanon. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/25/three-journalists-killed-in-israeli-attack-in-southern-lebanon (Al Jazeera)]
**The [[Israeli Air Force]] strikes the [[Syrian Armed Forces|Syrian military]]-controlled [[Jusiyah al-Amar|Jusiyah]]–[[Qaa]] [[border crossing]] on the [[Lebanon–Syria border]], accusing [[Hezbollah]] of using the border crossing to transfer weapons from [[Syria]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-says-it-carried-out-strike-on-lebanon-syria-border-crossing-used-by-hezbollah-to-smuggle-arms/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Kurdish–Turkish conflict]]
**[[2024 Turkish Aerospace Industries headquarters attack]]
***The [[Kurdistan Workers' Party]] claims responsibility for Wednesday's attack on the headquarters of the [[Turkish Aerospace Industries]] in [[Ankara Province]], [[Turkey]], which killed five people and injured dozens of others, saying that the attack had been "planned for a long time". [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20241025-kurdish-rebel-group-pkk-claim-deadly-attack-in-turkey-s-capital (France 24)]
*A [[Law enforcement in Bosnia and Herzegovina|police officer]] is killed and another is injured in a [[stabbing attack]] at a police station in [[Bosanska Krupa]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. The perpetrator, a 15-year-old boy, is arrested. [https://apnews.com/article/bosnia-attack-police-station-1f6802abd8011ce6eaf2bfe3d4eb273f (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Pacific typhoon season]]
**The death toll from [[Tropical Storm Trami (2024)|Tropical Storm Trami]]'s [[landfall]] in central and northern [[Philippines]] increases to 76 people, with more than 320,000 people evacuated. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/25/dozens-killed-as-tropical-storm-trami-batters-the-philippines (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2024 McDonald's E. coli outbreak]]
**The number of people who have become ill in an ''[[E. coli]]'' outbreak linked to [[McDonald's]] [[Quarter Pounder]] [[hamburger]]s in the United States increases to 75. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/us-fda-says-75-people-taken-ill-mcdonalds-ecoli-outbreak-2024-10-25/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 CrowdStrike-related IT outages]]
**[[Delta Air Lines]] files a lawsuit against cybersecurity company [[CrowdStrike]] after Crowdstrike's global outages in July forced the airline to cancel more than 7,000 flights, costing Delta Air Lines over $500 million. [https://www.reuters.com/legal/delta-sues-crowdstrike-over-software-update-that-prompted-mass-flight-2024-10-25/ (Reuters)]
*A high court in [[Gulu]], [[Uganda]], sentences former [[Lord's Resistance Army]] commander [[Thomas Kwoyelo]] to 40 years in prison on 44 counts of [[war crimes]] and [[crimes against humanity]], including [[enslavement]], [[torture]], and [[rape]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/uganda-ex-lra-rebel-commander-gets-40-year-sentence/a-70598776 (DW)]
*A man [[Familicide|fatally shoots two of his family members]] before killing himself in [[Huntsville, Ontario|Huntsville]], [[Ontario]], [[Canada]]. [https://barrie.ctvnews.ca/ontario-man-tells-police-he-harmed-two-family-members-three-found-dead-1.7088153 (CTV News Barrie)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Kiribati presidential election]]
**Citizens of [[Kiribati]] vote for the [[President of Kiribati|President]] between three candidates, incumbent [[Taneti Maamau]], Bautaake Beia from the [[Tobwaan Kiribati Party]], and [[independent politician|independent]] [[Kaotitaake Kokoria]]. [https://asia.nikkei.com/Politics/International-relations/Indo-Pacific/Kiribati-holds-presidential-election-with-pro-China-incumbent-in-focus (''The Nikkei'')]
*[[Premier of Ontario|Ontario Premier]] [[Doug Ford]]'s government announces that [[Ontario]] is planning to ban international students from medical schools in the province beginning in 2026. [https://www.pelhamtoday.ca/ontario-news/ontario-plans-to-bar-international-students-from-medical-schools-starting-in-2026-9710181 (Pelham Today)]
